name: Camp Danbee
description_short: An overnight camp for girls finishing 1st through 9th grade on Lake Ashmere in the Berkshires. Over 30 activities, from waterskiing and tennis to theater, gymnastics and pottery, with a 1:3 counselor to camper ratio and an emphasis on skill building over competition.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in Lake Ashmere and in two heated pools. The waterfront offers waterskiing, wakeboarding, sailing, paddleboarding, canoeing, kayaking and fishing.

sources.note: Prices are the tuition after October 1, 2026

warnings: This is the camp's general About page. It lists no season dates, prices or ages, so season_year and sessions are empty. Check the Dates and Rates page: https://www.campdanbee.com/about/dates-and-rates/
camp_type 'sleepaway' is inferred from the summer mailing and shipping addresses and the lakeside campus. The page never says 'overnight camp'.
The camp is for girls only ('It is a Girl's World at Danbee').

There are two addresses and phone numbers. The winter office is 4 New King Street, White Plains, NY 10604 (973-402-0606). The summer camp is in Peru/Hinsdale, MA (413-655-8115). It is currently the off-season, so the winter number may be the better contact.
